'''Fire Opal''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Magma Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Fire Opal is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Fire Opal is not used in any [[Cooking#Recipes|recipes]].

==Tailoring==
Fire Opal is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Purple Blouse]].  [[File:Shirt197.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a purple dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Fire Opal is not used in any [[quests]].

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}}
